note: Design record. No schema, migration, route, cron, binding or code exists for it.

decisions.STRUCTURED_STORE: Dedicated D1 database (future binding STATS_DB, own migrations dir); fallback = statistics_* tables in the existing DB. Owner decision at the schema gate.
decisions.RAW_ARTIFACT_STORE: ArtifactStore abstraction; durable implementation R2 (not bound anywhere today); metadata-only mode until then
decisions.SERIES_DIMENSION_MODEL: HYBRID: typed core dimension columns on the series row + indexed extension table (series_id, dim_code, value_code) + lossless source_key_json never queried
decisions.OBSERVATION_HISTORY_MODEL: Immutable observation versions keyed (series, period, release); write only on digest change; revision_class + supersedes pointer
decisions.CURRENT_PROJECTION_MODEL: Materialized statistics_current_observations (series_id, period_key) → current_version_id with denormalized value; same atomic batch; rebuildable
decisions.PROVENANCE_MODEL: Structural: every version carries release_id + run_id + source_locator (+artifact_id for files); runs carry adapter/parser/mapping versions; releases carry URL/terms; artifacts carry checksums; lineage graph at source level
decisions.INGESTION_RUN_MODEL: Worker plans/leases/admits; executors fetch→normalize and POST bounded batches; run status PLANNED→RUNNING→COMPLETED|PARTIAL|FAILED|CANCELLED with stage markers
decisions.CHECKPOINT_MODEL: Per bounded unit (source, dataset, scope_key); advances only on success; idempotency by deterministic ids + UNIQUE keys
decisions.SOURCE_ACTIVATION_MODEL: Runtime policy separate from registry: DISABLED(default)/CANARY_ONLY/ACTIVE/PAUSED/RETIRED; only owner-authorized moves up; machine may only pause
decisions.TIME_SENSITIVE_BRIDGE: One-way outbox (statistics_release_events) → optional bounded candidate into existing TIME_SENSITIVE triage; values suppressed unless republication gate PASS

platform_facts.cron: single * * * * * rotating one job per tick; Workers Free 10 ms CPU
platform_facts.d1_quota_note: 5M rows read/day shared with live Worker (docs/OPERATIONS.md §7)
platform_facts.migrations: 0001–0026 local; 0028–0030 on origin/main; 0027 reserved for localization-v2
platform_facts.runtime_precedent: evergreen_runtime_state: Worker-owned lease/cursor, hourly GitHub runner, bounded plan/complete
